title: Union Cement Company commissions 3Mt/yr Ras Al Khaimah cement grinding plant
summary: Union Cement Company commissions 3Mt/yr Ras Al Khaimah cement grinding plant
body_markdown:
**UAE:** Shree Cement subsidiary Union Cement Company has commissioned a new US$31.3m, 3Mt/yr grinding plant in Ras Al Khaimah. The plant is equipped with a vertical roller mill, with an integrated grinding and separation system.


Press Trust of India News has reported that the plant increases the subsidiary’s installed cement capacity by 75%, to 7Mt/yr. India-based Shree Cement has a total global production capacity of 76.3Mt/yr. It has a renewable power generation capacity of 635MW, accounting for 66% of group energy consumption in the first quarter of the (current) 2027 financial year.
